body: ### What are you really trying to do? In my codebase I was using `continueAsNew` for the first time. The doc comment had a link to https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/what-is-continue-as-new/ and I wanted to see where it went to understand the concept better. ``` /** * {@link https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/what-is-continue-as-new/ | Continues-As-New} the current Workflow Execution * with default options. * * Shorthand for `makeContinueAsNewFunc()(...args)`. (See: {@link makeContinueAsNewFunc}.) * * @example * * ```ts * import { continueAsNew } from '@temporalio/workflow'; * import { SearchAttributeType } from '@temporalio/common'; * * export async function myWorkflow(n: number): Promise { * // ... Workflow logic * await continueAsNew(n + 1); * } * ``` */ export declare function continueAsNew(...args: Parameters): Promise; ``` ### Describe the bug The link 404s Using internet archive, I can see the old version: https://web.archive.org/web/20221203113426/https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/what-is-continue-as-new/ I believe the correct link would be https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution/continue-as-new#continue-as-new Note: there are other examples of dead links - all `https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/*` 404 ### Minimal Reproduction ``` ❯ curl -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code}" -L https://docs.temporal.io/concepts/what-is-continue-as-new/ 404% ``` ### Environment/Versions Not relevant ### Additional context I'll have a PR up soon to fix it. CONTRIBUTING.md requested starting with an issue.
title: [Bug] Dead Links in Docs
